Oracle Fusion 26C: former opt-ins now standard

Oracle's Current Opt-In Expirations list names 36 features whose opt-in period ended with 26C. They are now standard: 14 are switched on automatically, and 22 need setup if you want to use them. By area: 19 in ERP and Supply Chain, 17 in Permitting and Licensing.

Oracle's note: if you already opted in and finished the setup, nothing changes for you. "Now enabled" and "Oracle's impact" are Oracle's own columns.
